head: IronFox is a simple workout log that shows your progress
dek: IronFox lets you log workouts and see how your fitness is progressing over time. It was #44 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It came out on 5 November and costs $2.99, by Cameron David Fox.
means: If gym apps feel too complicated, this one keeps it to logging and progress.
todo: Find IronFox in the App Store.
